_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all projects. Edit this file, then run `npm run build:projects` (or `npm run build`). The build generates js/projects-data.js (homepage cards) and injects <head> SEO meta + series navigation into each projects/<slug>/index.html between marker comments. RULES: (1) `slug` is permanent — it is the folder name + URL and must NEVER change; rename the `name` field freely instead. (2) Never hand-edit generated regions (marked GENERATED).
